sentences.en: Nowruz is the first day of spring.
sentences.target: نوروز د پسرلي لومړۍ ورځ ده.

sentences.en: Families clean their homes before the new year.
sentences.target: کورنۍ له نوي کال مخکې خپل کورونه پاکوي.

sentences.en: We cook seven fruits — haft mewa.
sentences.target: موږ اوه مېوې پخوو — هفت مېوه.

sentences.en: People visit their relatives and neighbors.
sentences.target: خلک خپلوانو او ګاونډیانو ته ورځي.

sentences.en: In Mazar-e-Sharif, the flag is raised.
sentences.target: په مزار شریف کې جنډه پورته کېږي.

sentences.en: May your new year be blessed.
